title: MCP AnimagineXL
summary: How can image generation be exposed through MCP and REST without hiding the GPU boundary?
context: An exploration of tool contracts over local models, packaging, and GPU resources.
constraints: Large models and GPUs are operational dependencies.
MCP and REST must describe the same capability.

decisions.title: Two boundaries
decisions.body: MCP serves agents; REST keeps a conventional integration path.

evidence.label: Implementation
evidence.detail: Server, endpoints, and Docker in the repository.

limits: A laboratory, not a product or production service.
Capacity and latency depend on model and hardware.
